summary: Bout to walk my son, the youngest, bucket in hamd down to the crik to collect water to flush the John I should probably write a poem about this.. Someday, what happens with the third Kid. #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bout to
walk my son,
the youngest,
bucket in hamd
down to the crik
to collect water
to flush the John
I should probably write
a poem about this..
Someday, what happens
with the third
Kid.
#smallpoems
